headline: HSIE Results Daily: Hindustan Aeronautics, Hitachi Energy, Alkem Laboratories, Bharat Dynamics, Manappuram Finance, Star Cement

highlights: HSIE Research is also available on Bloomberg ERH HDF <GO> & Thomson Reuters 13 November 2026 HSIE Results Daily HSIE Results Daily Contents Results Reviews ■ Hindustan Aeronautics: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd reported a healthy Q2FY27 performance, reflected in 15% revenue growth YoY to INR 76.1bn (marginal beat of 2%).
EBITDA at INR 17.4bn was a miss of 6%, as EBITDA margin of 22.8% fell short of the consensus estimates by 220 bps.
Higher material costs led lower gross margin was the primary reason behind pressure on profitability.
Lower contribution of high margin services business to the overall revenue was another driver.
valuation: Given growth is peaking out, we have cut our valuation multiple from 65x to 55x.
HAL and IAF have targeted to induct the first squadron of Tejas MK1A by March 2027 (1 squadron has 18-20 aircrafts), with management guiding ~24 aircraft deliveries each year.
watch: Key risks include geopolitical tensions, commodity price volatility, and execution complexity, though ~70% of contracts carry variable price clauses as a natural hedge.
With volume growth expected to rebound in H2FY27, better pricing and stable fuel cost outlook, we estimate Star will continue to deliver INR 1,400/MT+ margin until FY28E.
